title: Course Offering – Generate Courses – Academic Year Selected – Course Offering Created and Linked
description: CRUD – Generate (Scenario) – Click Generate Courses on a Course Master, select an Academic Year, and verify a Course Offering is created and linked to the Course Master.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A Course Master GenCO_TC exists with no Course Offering for Academic Year 2026
- Academic Year 2026 exists in the system
steps_actions:
1. "Open the detail page of GenCO_TC"
2. "Click Generate Courses"
3. "Select 2026 in the Academic Year field"
4. "Leave Location empty"
5. "Click Add"
6. "Click the Course Offering tab on the Course Master detail page"
7. "Click the newly created Course Offering record"
steps_result:
1. "Detail page opens; Course Offering related list shows 0 items"
2. "Generate Course dialog opens with Academic Year and Location fields"
3. "Academic Year field shows 2026"
4. "Location field remains blank"
5. "Dialog closes; success feedback is shown"
6. "Course Offering list shows 1 item: [2026] GenCO_TC linked to Academic Year 2026"
7. "Detail page opens; Course Master = GenCO_TC, Academic Year = 2026, Name = [2026] GenCO_TC"
